speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To understand what is wrong, can you tell me if you have been vomiting, and if so, is the vomiting forceful or projectile?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given the tenderness on palpation, has the baby passed any stools recently, and if so, have they been unusually foul-smelling or resembling "peanut butter"? Also, have you noticed an olive-shaped lump in the upper right abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyloric Stenosis

The baby has been vomiting, and if so, is the vomiting forceful or projectile?
